card.name: Inside interacting drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name that is being spelled out in an interaction passage, such as thioridazine, cilostazol, ledipasvir, theophylline or ethosuximide. Also fires on the space in section number lists and on 'in' after 'alone and' in overdose text.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug name, usually the interacting drug named after 'of', 'and' or 'to'.

modes.label: Cross-reference spacing
modes.description: The space before a section number in lists of cross-references.

modes.label: Alone and in combination
modes.description: The word 'in' after 'alone and' in overdose reports.
modes.example: These include overdoses with paroxetine alone and<< in>> combination with other substances.
